[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Lowes Companies, the publicly traded home improvement retailer listed on the NYSE under ticker LOW and headquartered in Mooresville, North Carolina, operates a data center in San Antonio, Texas, in the Westover Hills area of Bexar County. The project was first announced in 2006 as an approximately 68 million dollar, 100,000 square foot facility expected to employ about 30 permanent staff with up to 300 construction jobs during the building phase, part of a broader 2006 expansion push that also included 155 new Lowes stores nationwide. A current San Antonio business listing at the same Rogers Run address confirms the facility was in fact built and remains associated with Lowes today, though this registry relied primarily on the original 2006 trade press announcement for investment and size figures and did not independently verify current operational capacity, so those figures should be understood as reflecting the facilitys original scope rather than a confirmed present-day specification. As with other major retailers, Lowes data center exists to support the companys own retail operations, e-commerce platform, and supply chain and distribution systems rather than functioning as a commercial colocation offering to outside tenants. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
